kind: exact retained JavaScript slices in NodeVM with recording sinks
substitutions: Batch consumers record calls; they do not execute real animation queues.
Geometry probe runs ordinary _addResize/_addRotate and exact helper functions; _addAnimations runs collected callbacks immediately.
CSS size, current angle, AABB, expression values, events and element identity are explicit numeric sinks.
resize/rotate/circularMoveAndRotate consumers record requested CSS/arguments, not real animated DOM results.
No vendor GUI, DLL invocation, browser, product test/build/package, or network request.
